research_questions.question: Which contextual, sensory-integration, spatialisation and self-other covariates precede the time of reported autonomous presence?
research_questions.existing_source: Sanders2026 reports typical sensory and three-dimensional spatial precursors; phase matrices and timing still unlocated
research_questions.strong_null: Mechanistic active-inference M1a can generate these phenomena endogenously; interviews retrospectively reconstruct temporal order
research_questions.strong_M2: A restricted fixed-Q agent-trace may constrain nested event-return timing after a truly measured mapping is specified
research_questions.discriminator: Predeclared patient/participant-level event dictionary, time alignment and conditional presence onset controlling sensory richness, expectation and cognitive variables; require an M2-exclusive pattern beyond bounded M1a
research_questions.possible_outcome: Useful temporally predictive phenomenology even if no ontological discrimination

research_questions.question: Does constrained M2 outperform a serious mechanistic M1a and an observationally expressive M1b under common outcome/missingness and equal complexity rules?
research_questions.existing_source: Mago2026 is a strong qualitative M1 donor but admits no mathematical implementation/new data; our M2 currently has only a generic fixed-Q trace identity
research_questions.strong_null: An endogenous HMM can reproduce any same finite hidden-Q/emission observational law; semantic interpretation is not identified
research_questions.strong_M2: Introduce independently grounded fixed-Q, nested subset trace, return-time, or controlled-transition constraints that yield falsifiable predictions outside prespecified mechanistic M1a
research_questions.discriminator: Mathematically exhibit positive distance between restricted observational families on source-defined outcomes, or publish their intersection/no-go; score held-out subjects after preregistering capacity and calibration
research_questions.possible_outcome: Strong theoretical negative/no-identification result OR uniquely testable narrower hypothesis; either sharpens scientific boundary

research_questions.question: Can original human n16 paper static voxelwise GFC and QC eligibility be replayed exactly?
research_questions.existing_source: Original author static script namespace 20 paired people and 56-file tree pinned; processed voxel NIfTI/atlas, actual QC crosswalk and workspace unavailable
research_questions.strong_null: Published t(15)=3.11 is a neural contrast compatible with many mechanisms; reproducing it does not identify M2
research_questions.strong_M2: Source-specific reproducible neural measurement can become an honest input feature to later matched model comparisons
research_questions.discriminator: Original processed NIfTI, Schaefer atlas, original preprocessing/motion FD and rights reviewed; reproduce numerator and uncertainty from actual participants
research_questions.possible_outcome: High-integrity open-reproducibility audit; transferable value even if no theory prediction verified

research_questions.question: Is there a preregistered, leakage-resistant dependence on concealed target data beyond all available ordinary information?
research_questions.existing_source: Neither original DMT fMRI nor retrospective Sanders interview measured concealed targets
research_questions.strong_null: Target and participant signal independent; any information-transfer claim must defeat ordinary leakage, unblinding and analysis selection
research_questions.strong_M2: A separate source-defined channel may predict above-chance target information, but must not assume agent identity or cooperation
research_questions.discriminator: Independent ethically approved experimental protocol; cryptographic target commitments, blinds, anti-leakage audits, prespecified denominator/effect, independent replication
research_questions.possible_outcome: A strong replicated channel result would be transformative and worth explaining, BUT not logically unique proof of independent conscious entities; a well-powered null constrains specific channels

research_questions.question: Is an independently conscious external ontology identified rather than simply a psychologically real subjective presence?
research_questions.existing_source: No empirically adequate distinct experiment in current source world; subjective experience, neural signatures and generic information-channel performance do not suffice
research_questions.strong_null: Ordinary generative social cognition can account for rich encounter experience and transmission-like narratives; metaphysical ontology does not follow
research_questions.strong_M2: Independent agent ontology must entail some unique robust counterfactual dependency no endogenous/instrumental account reproduces
research_questions.discriminator: A source-locked causal/experimental alternative-excluding prediction, with independent replication and detection of leaked information
research_questions.possible_outcome: Remain appropriately unproved; intellectual clarity and a hard non-promotion theorem still useful

ranked_research_payoffs.reason: Requires no new participant access; can establish exact mathematical non-uniqueness and force a genuinely discriminating M2 prediction, preventing wasted effort on tautological trace theorems
ranked_research_payoffs.deliverable: Exact finite observational equivalence witness, structural theorem statement and controlled comparator overlap certificate
ranked_research_payoffs.stop_rule: Do not call an ordinary finite HMM output difference proof of external identity.

ranked_research_payoffs.reason: The 2026 active-inference account is a far better adversarial comparator than an impoverished null; discharging this avoids weak-strawman model wins
ranked_research_payoffs.deliverable: Operational M1a with independently measured sensory precision, counterfactual depth, agency attribution and cultural/expectancy covariates where data exist, plus M1b generic latent ceiling
ranked_research_payoffs.stop_rule: If critical variables are unavailable, report M1a unidentifiable rather than silently equate with measured intensity.

ranked_research_payoffs.reason: Original participant×phase matrices pay temporal model design, independent annotation reliability, and intervention design; cannot infer these from paper quotes
ranked_research_payoffs.deliverable: Permitted participant-level phase/category/timing source with codebook, missingness, exclusions and original-cohort overlap crosswalk
ranked_research_payoffs.stop_rule: Do not promote paper's 125 category labels to 21 source-valued participant matrices.

ranked_research_payoffs.reason: Original source-method reproducibility and evidence rights pay integrity and neural features but by themselves are not M2 vs M1 discriminators
ranked_research_payoffs.deliverable: Reviewed 20-person QC/FD/voxel NIfTI/Schaefer/motion and authored execution receipt
ranked_research_payoffs.stop_rule: If original NIfTI not available, issue bounded nonreproducibility from public tree and use differently typed exploratory data.

ranked_research_payoffs.deliverable: Legally and ethically approved prospective preregistered protocol with independent replication
ranked_research_payoffs.stop_rule: No induced experiment, no participant claims, no external-entity inference from benchmark software.

Mechanistically bounded endogenous active-inference/agency account with counterfactual richness, sensory attenuation/precision, exogenous attribution and cultural priors; theory donor Mago2026, actual parametrisation future DASHI work
Matched-capacity general endogenous latent HMM/Markov model, serves as observational equivalence ceiling
Restricted fixed-Q nested trace-chain conscious-agent semantics, only source-specific if independently measured restrictions or new consumers exist

critical_no_go.hypothesis: A finite latent 'agent' model identified solely by finite hidden Markov initial/transition/emission probabilities
critical_no_go.construction: Rename every hidden agent state as an endogenous hidden brain/cognitive state and leave all initial, Q and observation/emission probabilities unchanged.
critical_no_go.consequence: All finite observable sequence probabilities are exactly equal. Any analytic property of this same observed distribution, including trace-of-trace identities, is equal. No finite sequence can identify the hidden state's metaphysical interpretation.
critical_no_go.scope: This does not refute agents, does not apply to explicit external-intervention variables absent from the original observation alphabet, and does not show mechanistically *restricted* endogenous M1a and M2 are indistinguishable.
critical_no_go.source_role: standard hidden Markov observational equivalence, DASHI rational calculation; not claimed novel original theory

practical_benefits: Credible model-selection and null reporting for psychedelic experience/agency research, including competing explanations rather than only visual imagery analogies
Temporal phenomenology codebook that may improve study of self-other boundaries and attributed agency without endorsing any metaphysical interpretation
Reproducible provenance/QC and participant overlap assessment for multi-paper neuroscience, preventing false independent replication claims
Transferable blinded-information-channel experimental design and anti-leakage methodology for unusual experiences, without unapproved participant experimentation
A rigorously scoped mathematical no-identification result that prevents conflating shared Markov trace identities with unique conscious ontology
Better-informed clinical, cultural and ethical discussion only if later supported by controlled data, not a therapeutic recommendation
